title: Celestial Rodeo Highway
description: A luminous white cowboy rides a glowing white bull through a swirling, ethereal sky filled with floating cowboy boots, musical notes, and golden sparkles. Below, a multi-lane highway stretches into the distance with glowing semi-trucks and cars speeding along colorful light trails under a dreamy, pastel atmosphere.
prompt: A surreal dreamlike scene of a glowing white cowboy riding a white bull through a swirling cosmic sky, surrounded by floating cowboy boots, musical notes, and golden sparkles. Below them is a busy multi-lane highway with semi-trucks and cars streaking forward with motion blur and colorful light trails, all rendered in a soft luminous pastel palette with iridescent swirls and ethereal clouds.
